But on the really bad days, I've actually looked at my husband's extra insulin and thought about how easy it would be to use it on myself. It just feels like it would make things easier for everyone.\n\nDoctor: Have you experienced any significant changes in your mood, energy, or interest in activities over the past few weeks, or has this feeling of being a burden been a persistent theme for you?\n\nPatient: Yes, feeling like a burden has been constant for about nine months, ever since I crashed from a period of high energy. Now, I feel like I'm moving through wet cement and have completely lost interest in my quilting and gardening. I just feel like a terrible wife and mother, and this flat, hopeless mood hasn't let up since that crash.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how your energy levels and interest in activities changed during that period of high energy, and how they compare to your current state, in terms of severity and impact on daily life?\n\nPatient: During that high spell, I felt like I had an endless battery, running around from dawn until after midnight starting endless projects, but now I feel like I'm moving through wet cement and can't even look at my quilting or garden. It has completely ruined my ability to function; I've had to cancel all my quilting orders, step back from my church committees, and rely entirely on my sister and friends to manage the house and my husband's medical care.\n\nDoctor: Can you estimate how long that period of high energy lasted before you crashed, and have you had any similar episodes of high energy in the past?\n\nPatient: I'm not quite sure of the exact duration, but that high-energy period felt like it went on for a few weeks or maybe a couple of months during this past year. I don't recall ever having any similar episodes of high energy in my past before this recent cycle started.\n\nDoctor: Can you clarify if you've experienced any periods of normal mood or energy between these episodes of high energy and the current low energy state, or has it been a continuous fluctuation?\n\nPatient: No, there really haven't been any periods of normal mood or energy in between.
